name: experiment-skill
description: Slash commands for the computational-science documentation lifecycle: adopt, init, plan, capture, findings, report.

experiment-adopt.description: Audit an existing project and write adoption documentation before the lifecycle starts

experiment-init.description: Scaffold the experiment lifecycle files at the resolved research, code and work locations

experiment-plan.description: Define objectives, phases and success criteria for a workstream

experiment-capture.description: Record a process artifact (commands, data lineage, decisions, issues) from the session

experiment-findings.description: Synthesize results, process artifacts and plan criteria into a findings document

experiment-report.description: Compile an IMRAD-style report from all findings for a workstream
